subject: general
question: In a row of people standing in a waiting area, facing North, Hari stands seventh from the left end of the row and there are three people between him and the person standing at the exact centre of the row. How many people are standing in the row ?
solution:
In a row of people standing in a waiting area, facing North

 
• Hari stands seventh from the left end of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3797adffd7c1c997a962bc3633e19070b383b2cabaf4ea9e15744aece8083c10.png] 

 
• There are three people between hari and the person standing at the exact centre of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d5382b7ec660a88c85d1d40ea050bd5e92e6b6345ba13dbfadafacaf845a59f.png] 

**21** people are standing in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "21".
